verdict.rationale: Scoped API credentials for an agent are a fair question for an API platform like Stripe Financial Connections, so the axis applies. The pack shows an official MCP server and CLI, but nothing about restricted or least-privilege keys an agent could be issued. The per-account data access to balances, ownership and transactions is user-granted data permission, not scoped API credentials, so it is adjacent and earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
